abstract.t: This document specifies the Deterministic Evidence and Witness Protocol (DEWP), a format for tamper-evident audit commitments and offline evidence verification. It defines canonical event preimages, domain-separated hashing, two-tier Merkle inclusion proofs, per- tenant sequence checks, checkpoint continuity, and independently verifiable anchor evidence. Verifiers report content, commitment, embedded-signature, and anchor verification separately. Completeness checks cover committed events within the evaluated range; they cannot prove that an event was never withheld before commitment or that a committed description accurately records a real-world action. The specification also defines a streaming format that the reference implementations do not yet implement.
